summary: Iter 93 — Frontend-only verification of three feature changes on View Dezider. ALL THREE PASS end-to-end on the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via mobile viewport (390x844). (1) PROFILE CLEANUP: Logged in as super-admin (veales) → /profile shows the single 'Admin Console' shortcut (testID=profile-open-admin-console) with subtitle 'Experts, catalog, org, tiers, segments, ReviewNet & more'. The old long admin-module list (Experts, Templates, Catalog Manager, Tier Matrix, Customer Segments, Org Members, Pending Approvals, Decision Modes, Incident Response, Social Learning, Access Control, Admin Settings) is GONE from the profile body. AI Credits, Subscription, WhatsApp/Account, Decision Mode, Goals (GEM), TEPFI etc. are still present. Logged in as regular user (harden_*) → Admin Console shortcut is HIDDEN as required. (2) RENAME + REORDER: On /prr the top-right + opens the New menu — the FIRST card is 'Instant Dezider' (testID=new-menu-instant-dezider, subtitle '3-step gut check: situation → worst case → real needs'), followed by Decider, Pros & Cons, SWOT, Analyse a URL — confirmed via DOM testID order. Filter chips on /prr read 'Decider · Pros & Cons · SWOT · Instant Dezider · Solution Finder' (no Test123). Home dashboard §2 'Decision Kickstarters' shows Instant Dezider as the FIRST kickstarter card (before MyDezider — verified via code at app/(tabs)/index.tsx:439-453). Clicking 'Instant Dezider' in the New menu routes to /test123/new and renders 'Instant Dezider — Quick Decision' / 'Start Instant Dezider' / 'When to use Instant Dezider?'. The /test123 list page also renames correctly. (3) IMPORT FROM URL on Step 2: opened /prr/{decision_id}?step=2 → 'Import from a URL' card is visible with URL input (testID=step2-import-url-input) and Import button (testID=step2-import-url-btn). Entered http://localhost:9799/f.html, tapped Import → UrlAccessConsentModal opened with 'Agree & Analyse' (testID=url-consent-proceed) DISABLED (opacity 0.5, aria-disabled=true). Selected 'Free / public site' (testID=url-consent-elig-free_public) → still disabled. Tapped accept checkbox (testID=url-consent-accept) → button became ENABLED (opacity 1). Tapped proceed → POST /api/url-analyze/decision/{id}/import returned 200, success alert 'Imported from URL — Added 3 factors and 3 options from 3 items.' appeared, Step 2 listed the 3 factors. GET /api/decisions/{id} confirms factors=[1Y Return >=52.1, AUM >=212, Expense >=1.45] and options=[Alpha Fund, Beta Fund, Gamma Fund]. Navigated to Step 6 → all three fund options present, then Step 7 → Alpha Fund shows '29.7%' with '3/3 factors rated' and per-factor expected values displayed (e.g. '1Y Return >= 52.1'). Partial-assessment matrix is populated as required. ONE MINOR LEFTOVER FIXED: app/_layout.tsx line 342 still had headerTitle='Test123 - Quick Decision' which rendered as the modal-stack header above /test123/new — replaced with 'Instant Dezider - Quick Decision'.

action_items: All three review items PASS. No action required for the requested scope.

critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx:644-660 — Admin Console shortcut is gated by 'userRole !== "user"' which correctly hides it for the regular user role and shows it for super_admin/admin. Good single-source-of-truth pattern (one shortcut → /admin).

prr.tsx:507-520 — Instant Dezider is structurally placed FIRST inside the Modal's newMenuCard, ahead of Decider/Pros&Cons/SWOT. TYPE_META.test123.label='Instant Dezider' so filter chips/cards automatically render with the new label without further changes.

Step2.tsx:42-78 — runImport posts to /url-analyze/decision/{id}/import with {url, eligibility_type, custom_note, accepted:true} and calls fetchDecision() before alerting. Clean error handling reads detail from response. Sound.
UrlAccessConsentModal.tsx:43 — canProceed = !!elig && accepted && (elig !== 'custom' || customNote.trim().length > 0). Correctly enforces the 3-stage gate that the review demanded.
_layout.tsx:342 — FIXED stale headerTitle 'Test123 - Quick Decision' → 'Instant Dezider - Quick Decision'. (single-line testing-agent fix, business-safe).
